summary: [TTACart] End-to-end purchase flow: login, add to cart, checkout and order confirmation
description:
**Priority:** High
**Epic Link:** TTACart E-Commerce

**Description:**
As a customer, I want to log in to the TTACart store, add a product to my cart, and complete
checkout, so that I can place an order successfully.

The TTACart app is a standard e-commerce store with a username/password login, a products
page, a shopping cart, and a multi-step checkout.

**Exact URL paths (use these verbatim in test steps):**
* Login page: /playwright/ttacart/
* Products page (after login): /playwright/ttacart/inventory  (NOT /inventory.html)
* Cart page: /playwright/ttacart/cart
* Checkout info page: /playwright/ttacart/checkout-step-one
* Checkout overview page: /playwright/ttacart/checkout-step-two
* Order confirmation page: /playwright/ttacart/checkout-complete

**Exact UI text (use these verbatim in test steps):**
* Invalid-login error message: "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service"
* Order confirmation heading: "Thank you for your order!"

**Acceptance Criteria:**

1. Login
   * GIVEN I am on the TTACart login page
   * WHEN I enter a valid username and password and click Login
   * THEN I am redirected to the products page
   * AND an invalid username/password shows an "Invalid credentials" error message

2. Add to Cart
   * GIVEN I am on the products page
   * WHEN I click "Add to cart" on a product
   * THEN the cart badge in the header increments to show the item count

3. Cart Review
   * GIVEN I have added a product to the cart
   * WHEN I open the shopping cart
   * THEN the product is listed with quantity 1

4. Checkout
   * GIVEN I am in the cart
   * WHEN I click Checkout and enter First Name, Last Name and Zip/Postal Code and Continue
   * THEN I land on the Checkout Overview page

5. Order Total
   * GIVEN I am on Checkout Overview
   * WHEN I read the price block
   * THEN Item total + Tax equals the Total shown

6. Order Confirmation
   * GIVEN I am on Checkout Overview
   * WHEN I click Finish
   * THEN I see the "Thank you for your order!" confirmation page

**Out of Scope:**
* Payment gateway integration
* Order history / account management
